body.label: Target
body.html: Two visible empty supported spaces within 5 units of you and 3 units of each other.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Concentration: connect the spaces for up to 3 rounds. A willing creature can spend 1 Movement to travel between them if a clear path exists; this is not an extra Action and cannot cross solid walls.

surges.html: One willing creature using the connection before your next turn gains +1 Fortitude until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Space Thread
rider.html: Gain a Space Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: choose a visible empty space within 2 units as its origin. Measure its Range and area from that space.
